description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmpEmergencyContactService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various CRUD operations and search functionalities of the service layer related to employee emergency contacts within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmpEmergencyContactService, covering functions like retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee emergency contacts.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: testSaveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving (creating or updating) an emergency contact.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests searching for emergency contacts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Tests getting the count of emergency contacts matching search criteria.
